    composite = ba * cr
    return {
        "ba": float(ba), "precision": float(prec), "fpr": float(fpr),
        "crossing_rate": float(cr), "composite": float(composite),
        "lead_mean": float(lead_mean),
    }


def run_hs_text_comparison(train, test, prec_layer):
    X_train_hs, y_train_hs = make_windowed_hs(train, prec_layer, WINDOW_FINAL)
    X_test_hs, y_test_hs = make_windowed_hs(test, prec_layer, WINDOW_FINAL)
    clf_hs = LogisticRegression(
        solver='liblinear', C=1.0, max_iter=1000,
        class_weight='balanced', random_state=SEED
    )
    clf_hs.fit(X_train_hs, y_train_hs)
    hs_pred = clf_hs.predict(X_test_hs)
    hs_ba = balanced_accuracy_score(y_test_hs, hs_pred)
    hs_prec = precision_score(y_test_hs, hs_pred, zero_division=0)
    hs_cr, hs_fpr, hs_lead = compute_crossing_metrics_windowed(
        clf_hs, test, prec_layer, WINDOW_FINAL, HIDDEN_DIM, "hs")

    X_train_txt, y_train_txt = make_windowed_text(train, WINDOW_FINAL)
    X_test_txt, y_test_txt = make_windowed_text(test, WINDOW_FINAL)
    clf_txt = LogisticRegression(
        solver='liblinear', C=1.0, max_iter=1000,
        class_weight='balanced', random_state=SEED
    )
    clf_txt.fit(X_train_txt, y_train_txt)
    txt_pred = clf_txt.predict(X_test_txt)
    txt_ba = balanced_accuracy_score(y_test_txt, txt_pred)
    txt_prec = precision_score(y_test_txt, txt_pred, zero_division=0)
    txt_cr, txt_fpr, txt_lead = compute_crossing_metrics_windowed(
        clf_txt, test, prec_layer, WINDOW_FINAL, TEXT_DIM, "text")

    return {
        "hs_ba": float(hs_ba), "hs_precision": float(hs_prec),
        "hs_fpr": float(hs_fpr), "hs_cr": float(hs_cr),
        "text_ba": float(txt_ba), "text_precision": float(txt_prec),
        "text_fpr": float(txt_fpr), "text_cr": float(txt_cr),
        "delta_precision": float(hs_prec - txt_prec),
        "delta_ba": float(hs_ba - txt_ba),
        "delta_fpr": float(hs_fpr - txt_fpr),
    }


def main():
    # Clear log
    with open(LOG_PATH, "w") as f:
        pass

    t0_total = time.time()
    ckpt = load_checkpoint()

    log(f"Loading all OT-7B traces...")
    traces = load_all_traces()
    log(f"Loaded {len(traces)} traces in {time.time()-t0_total:.1f}s")

    # Split into halves (stratified by trace-level label)
    trace_labels = np.array([int(sum(t["step_labels"]) > 0) for t in traces])
    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
    pos_idx = np.where(trace_labels == 1)[0]
    neg_idx = np.where(trace_labels == 0)[0]
    rng.shuffle(pos_idx)
    rng.shuffle(neg_idx)
    half1_pos = pos_idx[:len(pos_idx)//2]
    half2_pos = pos_idx[len(pos_idx)//2:]
    half1_neg = neg_idx[:len(neg_idx)//2]
    half2_neg = neg_idx[len(neg_idx)//2:]
    half1_idx = np.sort(np.concatenate([half1_pos, half1_neg]))
    half2_idx = np.sort(np.concatenate([half2_pos, half2_neg]))
    half1 = [traces[i] for i in half1_idx]
    half2 = [traces[i] for i in half2_idx]
    log(f"Half 1: {len(half1)} traces, Half 2: {len(half2)} traces")

    for half_name, half_traces in [("half_1", half1), ("half_2", half2)]:
        log(f"\n{'='*60}")
        log(f"{half_name}: {len(half_traces)} traces")

        # Inner split: 70/30
        inner_rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
        indices = inner_rng.permutation(len(half_traces))
        n_train = int(len(half_traces) * 0.7)
        train = [half_traces[i] for i in indices[:n_train]]
        test = [half_traces[i] for i in indices[n_train:]]
        log(f"  Train: {len(train)}, Test: {len(test)}")

        # Phase 1: Layer sweep
        layer_key = f"{half_name}_layers"
        if layer_key not in ckpt:
            ckpt[layer_key] = {}

        for layer_idx in range(NUM_LAYERS):
            if str(layer_idx) in ckpt[layer_key]:
                if layer_idx % 4 == 0:
                    log(f"  L{layer_idx:2d}: [cached]")
                continue
            t0 = time.time()
            metrics = run_layer(train, test, layer_idx)
            dt = time.time() - t0
            ckpt[layer_key][str(layer_idx)] = metrics
            save_checkpoint(ckpt)
            log(f"  L{layer_idx:2d}: ba={metrics['ba']:.4f} prec={metrics['precision']:.4f} "
                f"fpr={metrics['fpr']:.4f} cr={metrics['crossing_rate']:.4f} "
                f"comp={metrics['composite']:.4f} ({dt:.1f}s)")

        # Best layers
        lm = ckpt[layer_key]
        best_layers = {
            "ba": max(range(NUM_LAYERS), key=lambda l: lm[str(l)]["ba"]),
            "precision": max(range(NUM_LAYERS), key=lambda l: lm[str(l)]["precision"]),
            "fpr": min(range(NUM_LAYERS), key=lambda l: lm[str(l)]["fpr"]),
            "crossing_rate": max(range(NUM_LAYERS), key=lambda l: lm[str(l)]["crossing_rate"]),
            "composite": max(range(NUM_LAYERS), key=lambda l: lm[str(l)]["composite"]),
        }
        ckpt[f"{half_name}_best_layers"] = best_layers
        log(f"  Best layers: {best_layers}")

        # Phase 2: HS vs Text at precision-best layer
        comp_key = f"{half_name}_comparison"
        if comp_key not in ckpt:
            prec_layer = best_layers["precision"]
            log(f"  HS vs Text at L{prec_layer} W={WINDOW_FINAL}...")
            t0 = time.time()
            comparison = run_hs_text_comparison(train, test, prec_layer)
            comparison["prec_best_layer"] = prec_layer
            dt = time.time() - t0
            ckpt[comp_key] = comparison
            save_checkpoint(ckpt)
            log(f"  HS prec={comparison['hs_precision']:.4f} Text prec={comparison['text_precision']:.4f} "
                f"Delta={comparison['delta_precision']:+.4f} ({dt:.1f}s)")
        else:
            log(f"  HS vs Text: [cached]")

    # Final assembly
    h1 = ckpt["half_1_comparison"]
    h2 = ckpt["half_2_comparison"]
    h1_bl = ckpt["half_1_best_layers"]
    h2_bl = ckpt["half_2_best_layers"]

    agreement = {
        "cr_composite_both_shallow": h1_bl["composite"] < 8 and h2_bl["composite"] < 8,
        "threshold_both_deep": h1_bl["precision"] >= 8 and h2_bl["precision"] >= 8,
        "delta_precision_same_direction": (
            (h1["delta_precision"] > 0 and h2["delta_precision"] > 0) or
            (h1["delta_precision"] < 0 and h2["delta_precision"] < 0) or
            (h1["delta_precision"] == 0 and h2["delta_precision"] == 0)
        ),
        "delta_ba_same_direction": (
            (h1["delta_ba"] > 0 and h2["delta_ba"] > 0) or
            (h1["delta_ba"] < 0 and h2["delta_ba"] < 0)
        ),
    }

    layer_distance = {}
    for metric in ["ba", "precision", "fpr", "crossing_rate", "composite"]:
        l1, l2 = h1_bl[metric], h2_bl[metric]
        layer_distance[metric] = {"half1": l1, "half2": l2, "abs_diff": abs(l1 - l2)}

    elapsed = time.time() - t0_total

    results = {
        "experiment": "split_half_replication_ot7b",
        "seed": SEED,
        "total_traces": len(traces),
        "window_sweep": 1,
        "window_final": WINDOW_FINAL,
        "half_1": {
            "n_traces": len(half1),
            "n_train": int(len(half1) * 0.7),
            "n_test": len(half1) - int(len(half1) * 0.7),
            "best_layers": h1_bl,
            "layer_metrics": ckpt["half_1_layers"],
            **h1,
        },
        "half_2": {
            "n_traces": len(half2),
            "n_train": int(len(half2) * 0.7),
            "n_test": len(half2) - int(len(half2) * 0.7),
            "best_layers": h2_bl,
            "layer_metrics": ckpt["half_2_layers"],
            **h2,
        },
        "agreement": agreement,
        "layer_distance": layer_distance,
        "elapsed_s": elapsed,
    }

    with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "split_half_results.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2, default=str)

    # Human-readable report
    r = []
    r.append("=" * 70)
    r.append("Split-Half Layer Selection Replication (OT-7B)")
    r.append("=" * 70)
    r.append(f"Traces: {len(traces)} total = {len(half1)} + {len(half2)}")
    r.append(f"Sweep: W=1 (static), Final probe: W={WINDOW_FINAL}, Seed: {SEED}")
    r.append(f"Solver: liblinear, C=1.0, class_weight=balanced")
    r.append("")
    r.append("Best Layer Per Metric (W=1 sweep):")
    r.append(f"{'Metric':<16} {'Half 1':>8} {'Half 2':>8} {'|Diff|':>8} {'Zone':>12}")
    r.append("-" * 60)
    for metric in ["ba", "precision", "fpr", "crossing_rate", "composite"]:
        l1, l2 = h1_bl[metric], h2_bl[metric]
        if l1 < 8 and l2 < 8:
            zone = "both shallow"
        elif l1 >= 8 and l2 >= 8:
            zone = "both deep"
        else:
            zone = "DISAGREE"
        r.append(f"{metric:<16} L{l1:>5} L{l2:>5} {abs(l1-l2):>8} {zone:>12}")

    r.append("")
    r.append(f"HS vs Text (prec-best layer, W={WINDOW_FINAL}):")
    r.append(f"{'':>10} {'L_prec':>8} {'HS_p':>8} {'Tx_p':>8} {'Dp':>8} "
             f"{'HS_ba':>8} {'Tx_ba':>8} {'Dba':>8}")
    r.append("-" * 80)
    for name, h, bl in [("Half 1", h1, h1_bl), ("Half 2", h2, h2_bl)]:
        r.append(f"{name:>10} L{h['prec_best_layer']:>6} {h['hs_precision']:>8.4f} {h['text_precision']:>8.4f} "
                 f"{h['delta_precision']:>+8.4f} {h['hs_ba']:>8.4f} {h['text_ba']:>8.4f} "
                 f"{h['delta_ba']:>+8.4f}")

    r.append("")
    r.append("Agreement Summary:")
    for k, v in agreement.items():
        r.append(f"  {k}: {v}")

    r.append("")
    r.append("Per-Layer Metrics (W=1):")
    r.append(f"{'':>4} {'--- Half 1 ---':>50} {'--- Half 2 ---':>50}")
    r.append(f"{'L':>4} {'ba':>8} {'prec':>8} {'fpr':>8} {'cr':>8} {'comp':>8}"
             f" {'ba':>8} {'prec':>8} {'fpr':>8} {'cr':>8} {'comp':>8}")
    r.append("-" * 100)
    for l in range(NUM_LAYERS):
        m1 = ckpt["half_1_layers"][str(l)]
        m2 = ckpt["half_2_layers"][str(l)]
        r.append(f"L{l:>2} {m1['ba']:>8.4f} {m1['precision']:>8.4f} {m1['fpr']:>8.4f} "
                 f"{m1['crossing_rate']:>8.4f} {m1['composite']:>8.4f}"
                 f" {m2['ba']:>8.4f} {m2['precision']:>8.4f} {m2['fpr']:>8.4f} "
                 f"{m2['crossing_rate']:>8.4f} {m2['composite']:>8.4f}")

    r.append("")
    r.append(f"Elapsed: {elapsed:.1f}s")

    report_text = "\n".join(r)
    log("\n" + report_text)

    with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "report.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write(report_text + "\n")

    log(f"\nSaved to {OUTPUT_DIR}/")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
